description: This file defines the ArraySerializer class responsible for serializing ResponseInterface instances to arrays and deserializing arrays back into Response objects within the Laminas Diactoros library. It provides static methods for conversion and error handling related to this process.

classes.name: ArraySerializer
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for serializing HTTP Response objects to arrays and vice versa, facilitating message processing and testing.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes a ResponseInterface object into an array containing status code, reason phrase, protocol version, headers, and body.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Deserializes an array into a Response object, reconstituting the response message, with error handling.

methods.name: getValueFromKey
methods.description: Retrieves a specific key value from an array, throwing a DeserializationException if the key is missing.
